Congrats on the quick ramp — I noticed your team crossed the 150k-token threshold on the self-serve project this week. That often means the best next step is a short 20-minute usage review so we can show a couple targeted ideas (KV caching, batching tweaks) that typically reduce cost and latency.

Would you be open to a 20-min session next week? A few open windows I have:
- Tue 5/11: 10:00–11:00am PDT

- Thu 5/13: 9:00–11:00am PDT

If none of those work, send me two slots that do and I’ll loop Ben (solutions engineer) in to run the demo. We’ll keep it focused: 10–15 min on your usage snapshot, 10–15 live demo of a configuration we think will help.

Attaching a one-pager about what we typically cover and a brief usage snapshot from your signup. Also dropped a HubSpot link for reference.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
